title: Hinomori Shiho — Our Sounds Combined〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Considering you said you were starting with a simple warm-up, you did really well just now, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to put in extra effort today since it's the day of our test.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Based on those notes that Shiho made, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's amazing that you're on track to cross everything off the list this week!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, why are you looking smug too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Because I helped out a whole lot♪
You've got this, girls!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin. We'll do our best!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that we're all warmed up, let's start.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Eliminating negatives like clumsy playing or rhythm issues is the baseline.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to be aiming beyond that into the positive to take our performance higher.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we can't reach the next level until we fix every issue on that list, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. I want you to perform as if you're really on stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be listening intently while checking the list for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, take it away.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Got it. Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Shih's amazing...!
She already started playing like it's the climax of the show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. You need every song in a show to be top-tier!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. But she certainly has been even more on top of her game lately.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't seem so surprised. Do you know something we don't?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You could say that. But, it's a secret.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's playing that eight-beat rhythm so energetically!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's my job to help her keep the beat, so I need to keep up...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honami followed my lead. Let's ride this wave!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Their sound is so exciting...! I gotta join them!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Steady... Listen carefully to the music...
Now!!!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yes, Saki! She's broken her habit of rushing ahead.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (...to nail the first note!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice! She's belting those notes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're sailing through the list items too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our sounds are coming together as one.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I barely gave them any time, and they still came this far.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But, we're not finished...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can go further!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(...!
Shiho's playing just...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone, follow me!)

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I will not be left behind!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I-It's over...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Luka, everyone. How did we do?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The first song was perfect. You all managed to keep up with Shiho's performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Had that been the real thing, it would have been an incredible start to a show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But, we're still on the first song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's right. Let's keep up the pace and get ready for the next one!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!
